claims.claim: It is a DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a handheld solar lantern with a LUMETT watermark but no readable DP Compact brand or model.
Report does not show scratches, cracks, or damage from all angles.
Photos cannot reveal repair history or whether the unit was opened.
Report does not show whether the lantern powers on or holds a charge.
Report does not show a receipt or warranty document.

risks.proof: Video of runtime under load or a battery health reading

risks.if_unproven: as lantern only, with no charger or cable

risks.risk: Hidden scratches, cracks, or damage not visible from the current angle

risks.risk: Age and warranty status are unknown; original packaging may be missing

proof_requests: Video of the lantern powering on and staying lit
Close-up photos of all sides, lens, and rear cover
Photo of any solar panel, charging cable, and accessories
Photo of original receipt and warranty card
Video demonstrating brightness settings and modes
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a handheld solar lantern, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's condition, function, and document claims are unproven and are priced accordingly.
